head: codex/5828-memory-palace-context-topology
title: [v0.92][WP-11][runtime] Implement the first Memory Palace context-topology slice
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5828

## Summary
- adds a deterministic Runtime v3 Memory Palace packet bound to WP-09 identity, WP-10 continuity, normalized ObsMem records, and exact trace citations
- enforces bounded working sets, digest-bearing overflow, canonical topology, temporal freshness, collision-resistant room IDs, and fail-closed privacy/redaction rules
- adds an issue-specific native macOS/Linux receipt workflow with exact inventory, provenance, artifact isolation, and semantic-equivalence validation

## Validation
- focused Memory Palace nextest: 12/12 passed
- strict Clippy and formatting: passed
- retained ObsMem/trace receipt validator: passed at source 41755b0e3b1fb927b19770243572aa028eb6444e
- exact-head native run 31385543888 passed 12/12 on Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64; the downloaded artifact independently validates at e20b9870dbc56ab59c68f123ed355af331ee5614 with identical semantic SHA b941f2a2d005d12b3a6b8c5b758817fe256196d2963fd0f749ed532e79a42fe2
- all required standard and native checks were green on the proven publication head; the final metadata projection must remain green before merge
